_: The authored half of the amethyst (Scoring) public record: dossiers written family by family, each with its declared nature and a one-sentence reason. No real person, no real company, and no official risk list copied: countries are plausible ISO codes spread across ordinary jurisdictions, and every risk-bearing fact lives in the dossier's own declared fields (opaqueJurisdiction, ownershipLayers, ratios), never in a country name. The set earns its keep through the twins: domestic-sme mirrors shell-layers with every layer named, local-shop mirrors cash-intensive with turnover on its declaration, salaried mirrors undeclared-turnover at ratio one, retiree mirrors pep-relative without the flag, foreign-student mirrors remote-newcomer-burst at stipend scale, seasonal-exporter mirrors offshore-structure without the opacity. What separates each twin is in the fields, never only in the label, and a test pins it structurally.
